mentions.name: ColliePWA
mentions.description: A mobile PWA interface for continuing to work with your agents from a phone, meeting developers where they work on the desktop in terminal multiplexers like herdr/tmux/zellij. Remote access can be set up through any front door such as Tailscale, and it does not rely on third parties to run.
mentions.problem: Continuing to work with your agents when you're away from the desktop, without depending on third-party services.
mentions.audience: Developers who work with agents on the desktop in terminal multiplexers
mentions.source_excerpt: ColliePWA[1] a mobile interface to continue working with your agents when you're on the. Trying to meet devs where they work on the desktop in multiplexers (herdr/tmux/zellij). Remote access can be set up with any front door like tailscale.
